name: Spokane
source: Spokane County GIS / Assessor parcel publication

queries.query: Spokane County official parcel map GIS ArcGIS REST parcels
queries.result: Found the official Spokane County GIS and Assessor pages, SCOUT interactive parcel map, public ArcGIS parcel metadata, and the public Spokane County parcel Feature Service.

queries.query: Spokane County mapa parcelas GIS oficial
queries.result: The United States local/native service language is English; this discovery query returned the same first-party Spokane County Assessor/GIS parcel sources and no separate non-English local custodian.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official Assessor page identifies SCOUT as the interactive county property parcel map.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Spokane County public ArcGIS parcel service
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Anonymous service metadata returned a Parcels polygon layer in Web Mercator (WKID 102100/3857), maxRecordCount 2000, objectIdField OBJECTID, and native parcel field PID_NUM.
Metadata gives parcel geographic bounds and identifies PID_NUM plus OBJECTID; the retained sample uses PID_NUM as the native identity.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official SCOUT service was discovered, but direct retrieval was blocked in this environment; no bypass or TLS exception was attempted.
Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, Web Mercator CRS, safe identity candidate PID_NUM, and service field schema. Unsafe fields were not requested in feature queries.
Exact WUP point probe returned an empty FeatureCollection. The coordinate was preserved and not shifted; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
A bounded approximately 2 km square around the exact point returned three features with PID_NUM identities 35071.3404, 35071.3405, and 35071.3406.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Spokane County parcel service; Spokane is within the published county dataset bounds.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Service metadata plus a bounded nearby parcel response; exact point had zero intersecting features.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Spokane County GIS/Assessor custodianship is evidenced by official county pages and parcel publication.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: Three returned Polygon features were retained unchanged after output transformation to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON.
qualityAssessment.crs: Source layer declares EPSG:3857 / WKID 102100; query requested output EPSG:4326.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: PID_NUM is the source parcel-number field and was returned with geometry; OBJECTID is a generated Esri feature number and was not used.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only PID_NUM and geometry were requested. Owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, and document fields were not requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify live service stability, native identity semantics, CRS/axis handling, Spokane city coverage, and safe field behavior before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [47.6749186972462,-117.404067884856] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact-point zero hit and bounded extent response are representative probes, not a citywide survey.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
identityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON properties contain exactly one canonical native identity, id, sourced from PID_NUM; native field mapping and CRS provenance are recorded in this metadata instead.
